events.title: Flap overspeed
events.description: IAS above the VFE for the flap angle, which comes from the aircraft's type profile (profiles/<ICAO>.yaml, manufacturer's airspeed limitations). Silent without a profile. Levels above VFE are a FOQA-Sim estimate.
events.why_it_matters: Exceeding VFE stresses the flap structure and its attachments beyond what they were certified for; it can damage the flaps and requires a maintenance inspection.
events.advice: Reduce speed below VFE (the top of the white arc) before extending the flaps, and retract them before accelerating beyond it.

events.title: Excessive bank below 500 ft
events.description: Bank angle below 500 ft, held 3 s. EASA Data4Safety, below 500 ft: more than 15 deg (SL2B) or 30 deg (SL3). Light aircraft: `bank-light`.
events.why_it_matters: Steep bank close to the ground raises the stall speed (about 7% at 20 deg, 41% at 45 deg) and risks a wingtip strike; a stall in a low turn is rarely recoverable.
events.advice: Plan the pattern so the turn to final is complete with shallow bank (15 deg or less) well above 500 ft. Overshooting final: go around, do not tighten the turn.

events.title: Hard landing (light aircraft)
events.description: Peak normal load at touchdown, light aircraft (normal-category limit load 3.8 g). Levels are a FOQA-Sim estimate.
events.why_it_matters: A firm touchdown stresses the gear, the gear attachments and the propeller clearance; repeated hard landings cause structural damage.
events.advice: Approach at the published speed, start the flare at about 10-20 ft and hold the aircraft off while the speed bleeds. Bounced or ballooned: go around.

events.title: Bounced landing
events.description: More than one main-gear air-to-ground transition (EASA EOFDM RE30).
events.why_it_matters: A bounce leaves the aircraft airborne, slow and nose-high near the runway; the second touchdown is often harder and can strike the nose gear or the tail.
events.advice: On a light bounce, hold the attitude and let it settle; on a high bounce, go around with full power. Prevent it with a stable approach and a proper flare.

events.title: Excessive bank below 500 ft
events.description: Bank angle below 500 ft, held 3 s. EASA Data4Safety, below 500 ft: more than 15 deg (SL2B) or 30 deg (SL3). Light aircraft: `bank-light`.
events.why_it_matters: Steep bank close to the ground raises the stall speed (about 7% at 20 deg, 41% at 45 deg) and risks a wingtip strike; a stall in a low turn is rarely recoverable.
events.advice: Plan the pattern so the turn to final is complete with shallow bank (15 deg or less) well above 500 ft. Overshooting final: go around, do not tighten the turn.

events.title: Long landing
events.description: Touchdown beyond the touchdown zone, whose length is min(3000 ft, LDA/3) of the landing runway (sources to be confirmed: FAA P/CG 3000 ft, one-third rule). Needs the airport data recorded in flight.
events.why_it_matters: Touching down beyond the touchdown zone eats runway needed to stop: a leading cause of runway excursions.
events.advice: Aim for the touchdown zone markings at the target speed, do not float. If you will not be down in the touchdown zone, go around.

events.title: Touchdown off the runway centreline
events.description: Distance of the touchdown from the runway centreline. Levels are a FOQA-Sim estimate. Needs the airport data recorded in flight.
events.why_it_matters: Touching down off the centreline reduces the margin to the runway edge and increases the risk of a lateral runway excursion.
events.advice: Correct for crosswind (wing low or crab and kick) and track the extended centreline down to touchdown.
events.detail: 31 ft off the centreline, limit 25 ft
